label: fix 1: review
result:
I fixed all 18 skeptic failures in `/Users/workingmyassof/satbank/spec/v2-upgrades/review.md`. No earlier fixer had touched the file, so every fix here is new. I committed nothing and changed no other file.

- **V1, a list that ends:** the day's list is now frozen at local midnight in a new `due_days` table. Done items stay on the list with a ✓, and nothing new joins before tomorrow. Undone items keep their normal place in the order tomorrow, and mixing topics only reorders the frozen list.
- **V1, size:** the list is now sized to the minutes on the pill at the student's own median pace (10 min at 95 s is 6 items), so "Start review · 10 min" covers exactly today's list. New checks include "answer every item and `left == 0` while more wait".
- **V1, one daily model:** `review.due` now extends Today's Warm-up list (T3's candidates). Today's Warm-up row becomes a Review row that counts toward Today's totals, `warmup` is an alias of `due`, and Up next's check-in and redo rows start the same body. There is one set of time-box chips site-wide. `/api/today.due`, `/api/me.review.due_left` and `/api/review/due.left` must be the same number.
- **Snoozes and badge:** "Not today" is stored on the server (`prefs.snooze`, `POST /api/review/snooze`), so every device and count agrees. The badge shows both numbers (`6 due · 25 open`) with no tooltip-only figure.
- **Clean means unseen:** `progress.record` marks an answer as a repeat whenever the key could already have been read, which now includes blanks on a finished sitting's paper. The access rule is widened to match.
- **V18 worksheets:** they print without the key. The key is offered after Submit, and printing it earlier sets `cfg.key_printed`, so later answers file as repeats.
- **V2 walk:** a new `attempts.revealed_at` column plus `POST /api/review/seen` record when a key was shown. "Try again" appears only while that is empty, and the report opens a New miss at "What happened?" first.
- **V8 tries and Mixed:** History items carry every try, and Mixed is a result in the filter, the summary card, the sitting cells and the modal. Each row expands to show every try.
- **V13, discard answers:** "Discard this sitting's answers…" has a confirm sheet that states the counts. It uses `POST /api/session/{sid}/void` and `/unvoid`, and rolls traps back from the trap log, so it can be undone.
- **V13, blanks:** sitting cells are built from the paper, with blanks drawn dashed. There is a "Blanks · n · fresh twins" action, and the walk covers blanks as "Didn't answer".
- **V13, miss actions:** there are now only two, each labelled with its effect: "Walk these misses · name each, then prove it" and "Fix on new numbers · n q · Then → Now". The old "Fix the misses" (`from_session`) is now an alias of the second. "Again, exactly" is in the overflow only.
- **V15 options:**
  - Volume is `5 · 10 · 20 · 30 · 40 · 50 · All` plus a number field.
  - Feedback is only on Marked, Saved and History; fixing tabs read "Instant · fixing set".
  - Due has a single sizing control, the header's minutes.
  - `tools/seed_ratings.py` spreads the level priors before launch, with an assert that each of L1–L7 holds at least 5% of types.
- **V3 Saved:** "Practise due" and "Fresh versions of selected · n" (1, 2 or 3 each) are both always offered.
- **V11 explanation depth:** steps are written first for the templates students miss most (`tools/steps_queue.py`). S10's checks require 80% of open traps to sit on templates with steps before that scorecard row claims WAY BETTER. Templates without steps show a value line per option.
- **Domain:** the pane meta now starts with the domain, and History rows, Marked rows and the CSV carry it.
- **Nothing hidden (decision 4):**
  - On phones, options and secondary actions show as visible wrapping rows, with no Options fold.
  - Redo groups show every row, paged by 50.
  - "Your instincts" lists every reading that qualifies.
  - "2 unsure" and "not answered" are back in the tile sub-lines.
- **V5 blind spots:** a miss under 25% of the question's time budget is Rushed, never an assumed "sure". An inferred case reads "Fast answer · assumed sure".
- **V14 result strip:** a per-tab table says what each cell shows: answer results, mistake status pips, or check-in states.
- **Decision 5:** I removed the "until teachers ask" wording and replaced the "class homework is U27's" line with "no classes; a friend takes the same worksheet through a shared sets link". The file had no Compete class-group references to convert.
- **Scorecard:** rows 1, 4, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 19, 21 and 26 are rewritten with matching verdicts, and I added row 27 (one daily review) and row 28 (decision 4).
- **Overrides:** the §3.1 items and the §3.2 table for sibling specs are updated to match all of the above. That includes entries for Today (T2, T3, T9), Up next (U1), Practice (P11, P19, P1), S4, S6, and the shared data and prefs sections. Those files still need editing by their owners to carry out the changes.
